Ryan Reynolds Crashes SDCC Panel, Robert Downey Jr. Shuts Him Down

At the San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) panel for 'Avengers: Doomsday', Ryan Reynolds crashed the event dressed as Deadpool to beg for a role in the film. Robert Downey Jr., playing Doctor Doom, shut down Reynolds' attempt and led to Chris Evans' return as Captain America.
